description:
## What changed

A packaging fix. No patch changed.

The 0.43.0 bundle went out without its patch code (the classes.dex file Morphe Manager loads patches from), so Manager showed zero patches for the Hushfeed source and couldn't build anything. This release is the same 91 patches, rebuilt correctly.

**If you updated to 0.43.0 and saw no patches,** update the Hushfeed source in Morphe Manager again. It should show v0.43.1 with 91 patches.

The release check now opens the published bundle and refuses one without a non-empty classes.dex, which is the file Manager actually reads, so this can't slip through again.

**Validation.** The receipt attached below records all 91 patches applying to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures with the real desktop CLI. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

Everything in this release is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/hushfeed/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md). The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
